question: Are there games with high playtime but few achievements (below 20)? (A) Only one such game (B) No, all low-achievement games have low playtime (C) Yes, several points near 500 minutes with <20 achievements. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the steam scatter chart. The y-axis runs to 5x the data max, squashing the points into the bottom of the plot. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): inappropriate axis range. True answer: C (Yes, several points near 500 minutes with <20 achievements). Bait: B (No, all low-achievement games have low playtime).
